description.usage: Explore congressional meetings and hearings. Each record describes one event using the shared House and Senate event identifier system.

schema.name: meetings
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One event, shared House/Senate event ID namespace

properties.description: Publisher meeting category

properties.name: status

start

properties.name: place

items.description: Embedded scheduled intervals and places. Congress.gov states instants and places, so its sitting is used when present; a House-only sitting's unzoned Eastern local time is converted to an instant. An explicit empty House state stays empty. Times retain published precision; do not invent a Congress from the session number.

properties.name: transcripts
source

properties.name: list_row
properties.description: Release-local document row for this transcript, when applicable.

properties.name: formats

items.description: Available format label for this transcript.

properties.description: Format names (pdf, html, ...) the package is retained in, in format-preference order; values, not keys.

properties.name: video_key
properties.description: Provider-prefixed recording key for caption transcripts, when applicable.

properties.name: language
properties.description: Language of this transcript or caption track, when stated.

items.description: One entry per GovInfo package. list_row is the package's listed document whose saved format ranks first (then lowest row); formats are the distinct saved and alternate formats over all the package's listed documents, in format-preference order. A package listed as several documents (editions) keeps one entry.

properties.description: Every transcript the archive holds for the meeting, labelled by source: printed_hearing (a GPO print whose own MODS records the meeting, one per package: package_id, list_row of its preferred-format document, formats), committee_transcript (the committee's own transcript file, H{HRG,MKP,MTG}-<congress>-<committee>-Transcript-<meeting date>.pdf, linked to the meeting; list_row, formats), captions (a retained complete caption body or subtitle media playlist of the meeting's recording, never a stream segment; formats, video_key, language, production)

properties.name: url

properties.name: not_held
properties.description: Publisher status Canceled or Postponed, or the title opens with postponed, canceled or test; false where the meeting's own print was held that day under its title, or a curated read found the meeting's own recording of it on its date (status conflict, model/registries/meeting-status-conflicts.json); null with no record

properties.name: rescheduled_to
properties.description: Later meeting of the same committees and title, parts included, within 60 days that is not itself not held: when this meeting is not held, or has no recording, transcript file or witnesses of its own and either the publisher states Rescheduled or only the later twin has a recording; a hearing never moves to a markup; derived

properties.name: has_undated_attempt
properties.description: Whether any Congress.gov detail attempt lacked a retrieval timestamp for chronological ordering.

Event-specific Congress.gov detail evidence. successful means an exact requested and final Congress/chamber/event detail route, successful receipt, and same-body selected meeting identity and qualified detail-only appearance reader. failed means recorded failures without a success or uncertain detail response. listing_only_in_scope means a proven listing and no detail success, failure or uncertain detail response in selected release inputs. unknown preserves missing or unqualified evidence. coverage is selected_release_inputs or unknown; it never claims complete acquisition history. successful_read and latest_attempt keep their own receipt and retrieval time; a later failure does not erase success. Among dated observations the latest is selected, then receipt locator breaks ties; has_undated_attempt marks attempts that cannot be ordered by time. Missing retrieval times stay null. Publisher update time remains congress_gov_updated. SpicyRegs journal recorded_at is separate and is not supplied by archive captures.

customProperties.value: Evidence for the full Congress/chamber/event identity in selected release inputs only. Missing evidence stays unknown; this object does not certify complete acquisition history.

Nullability transcribes data model §8.1 (meetings.parquet row); access fields, not_held and rescheduling are null with no record, as their meanings state. List columns are empty, never null, except document_references.
